::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-web">Videos</span>

**Four new one-minute videos.** Who runs the water service and what happens to the bill; whether women and men save water at home in the same way; the water services of small villages; and how precise official surveys are. Each video explains its **link with inequality**. [Watch them](videos.qmd).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Project</span>

**Objective OG1 achieved.** The first general objective of the project, *identify and reduce the bias in studies based on the Gini index*, has been completed. Its results are published in *Sociological Methods & Research* and *Social Indicators Research* and implemented in [giniVarCI](software.qmd). See the [conclusions](results.qmd#og1).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-paper">Open access</span>

**More articles in open access.** 27 of the 48 articles of the project can now be read free of charge: 17 in [DIGIBUG](https://digibug.ugr.es/), the open repository of the University of Granada, and the rest in repositories of partner universities or open-access journals. Look for **🔓** in [Publications](publications.qmd).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-web">Videos</span>

**Our research in one minute.** Eight [one-minute videos](videos.qmd) explain, in plain language, the team's articles on inequality and poverty: the Gini index, the "happy and poor" paradox, water and sanitation, tourism, young talents' earnings and innovation. They are also published in the [blog](blog/index.qmd).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-web">Website</span>

**New GiniUs website.** The project website moves to Quarto, with new interactive tools that run in the browser: a [Gini index calculator](calculator.qmd), a [missing data simulator](missing-data.qmd) (MCAR, MAR and MNAR), an [interactive bias explorer](simulation.qmd), [R exercises](practice.qmd) and an [inequality observatory](observatory.qmd).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">23 October 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conference</span>

**IX EIEE (Ciudad Real).** J.F. Muñoz Rosas chairs the session on Quantitative Methods at the IX Encuentro Internacional de Especialización para la Investigación en Economía y Empresa, hosted by the University of Castilla-La Mancha, and P.A. Cano-Chica presents the project paper on confidence intervals for the Foster–Greer–Thorbecke poverty indices. [More information and photo](dissemination.qmd#eiee).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">10 September 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Workshop</span>

**Working group on inequality at the XVIII AECPA Congress (Granada).** Members of the project organise the working group *Inequality, measurement and public policies* (GT 5.4), coordinated by S. López Ruiz with E. Álvarez Verdejo as discussant, with papers by J. Guardiola, J.F. Muñoz, F. González-Gómez, P.J. Moya and S. López Ruiz. [Programme and papers](dissemination.qmd#aecpa).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">September 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Project</span>

**The project enters its fourth and last year** (September 2026 – August 2027).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">April 2026</span> <span class="news-tag tag-paper">Publication</span>

**A practical guide to proper estimation and inference of the Gini index by avoiding often encountered methodological pitfalls**, by J.F. Muñoz, J.M. Pavía and E. Álvarez-Verdejo, published in *Social Indicators Research*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11205-026-03831-x) · [Video](videos.qmd#gini-practical-guide)
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">December 2025</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conference</span>

**The Gini index and giniVarCI at CrossMED 2025.** J.F. Muñoz Rosas presented *The Gini index in inequality research: theory and practice with the R package giniVarCI* at the international conference *Landscapes Across the Mediterranean* (2nd edition), University of Granada, 9–11 December 2025. [More](dissemination.qmd#conferences-2025).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">June 2025</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conference</span>

**Water services and the right to water at the University of Jaén.** F. González-Gómez and J.A. Rodríguez Martín presented two papers at the II International Congress *The value of water: new perspectives in a global world* (Jaén, 5–6 June 2025): one on the challenges of the water services of small municipalities of Granada and one on the human right to water from the indigenous worldview in Latin America. [More](dissemination.qmd#jaen-2025).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">March 2025</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conference</span>

**Three contributions on the Gini index in Paris.** At ICMATAP-25 (7–8 March) and ICFM-25 (10–11 March), J.F. Muñoz Rosas presented results on skewness and confidence intervals, common pitfalls and the giniVarCI package, and a new weighted estimator that reduces the bias of the Gini index. [More](dissemination.qmd#conferences-2025).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">February 2025</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Transfer</span>

**A tariff guide for Spanish water services.** F. González-Gómez and D. Ortiz Rodríguez (University of Granada) wrote the update of the *Tariff Guide for urban water services*, funded by the Spanish Federation of Municipalities and Provinces (FEMP) and promoted by the FEMP and AEAS (now DAQUAS). It was presented at the FEMP headquarters in Madrid on 11 February 2025. [More](transfer.qmd).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">November 2024</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Conference</span>

**VIII EIEE (Cartagena).** Two papers by members of the project: common errors in the estimation of the Gini index and the giniVarCI library, and fast jackknife variances for Theil indices. [More information and photo](dissemination.qmd#eiee-2024).
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">22 May 2024</span> <span class="news-tag tag-project">Seminar</span>

**Seminar on the Gini index and the R package giniVarCI**, organised by the research group EPIC at the University of Granada. [See the photos](dissemination.qmd).
:::

<span class="news-date">January 2024</span> <span class="news-tag tag-paper">Software</span>

**The R package giniVarCI is published on CRAN** (version 0.0.1-3). [More information](software.qmd).
